If you mean free markets, then yes. That form is natural to humans and will exist as long as our brains are like this.

If you mean the current large-corporation stock-trade paradigm, then no.

Disruptive technology entering the market, will eventually distribute the means of production to the masses. Thus changing the economics of scale to favour small to medium businesses in contrast to Transnationals.

This will cause most of the wealth of the hyper rich to vanish, while the Average Joe becomes the generator of new wealth.

I guess that would be the upper limit or close to it based on how much longer we'll have oil supply. The form may continue until then but since oil prices are already on the rise the speed and momentum will certainly slow down exponentially as we move forward.

If the current trends of automation continue, then no, at least not on Earth.
